blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — AAn industry association in the United States is urging Philippine officials to keep the tariff classification of pork jowls as edible offal, warning that any reclassification would run counter to international standards. In a position paper to the Tariff Commission (TC), the National Pork Producers Council (NPPC), a group representing the US pork industry, said removing the jowl from the head does not change the jowl’s anatomical origin.
